quick_english: He has the sun and moon as eyes, is the eater of the universe, and has gone beyond all.

tokens.grounds: compound: sūrya+soma+īkṣaṇa; having sun and moon as eyes
compound: viśva+bhoktṛ; consumer of the universe
refers to all beings or everything
one who has gone beyond

quick_english: He is the lord of all worlds, free from possessiveness, unattached, and endowed with wondrous enjoyment.

tokens.grounds: compound: nirmama+akhila+loka+īśa; lord of all worlds free from possessiveness
compound: niḥsaṅga+adbhuta+bhoga+vat; unattached yet possessing wondrous enjoyment

quick_english: He is all, the lord of the goddess Śrī, and adorned with every ornament.

tokens.grounds: identifies the being as all-encompassing
refers to Śrī or prosperity
compound: pati+devī; lord of the goddess
compound: sarva+bhūṣaṇa+bhūṣita; adorned with all ornaments

quick_english: He is all-knowing among all the gods and the leader of all deities.

tokens.grounds: compound: samasta+deva+sarvajña; knower of all among all gods
compound: sarva+daivata+nāyaka; leader of all deities

quick_english: He is the armor of all the gods and the crest jewel of all the gods.

tokens.grounds: compound: samasta+deva+kavaca; armor for all gods
compound: sarva+deva+śiromaṇi; crest jewel of all gods

quick_english: He is all-pervading, the benefactor of all, and also the sun; he has slain his enemies and grants excellent delight.

tokens.grounds: compound with sandhi: vibhu+sarvahita+api+arka; all-pervading, benefactor of all, and also the sun
compound: hata+ari; one whose enemies are slain
compound: su+rati+prada; giver of excellent delight

quick_english: He is endowed with Brahmā and Śambhu as his halves, elder to Brahmā, yet a child, and self-ruling.

tokens.grounds: compound: brahmā+śambhu+parārdha+āḍhya; endowed with Brahmā and Śambhu as halves
compound: brahma+jyeṣṭha; elder or superior to Brahmā
paradoxically described as a child
sovereign, self-ruling

quick_english: He accomplishes all purposes, knows what is to be done, and has always abandoned action for his own sake.

tokens.grounds: compound: sarva+artha+kartṛ; accomplisher of all purposes
compound: kṛtya+jña; knower of what is to be done
compound: sva+artha+kṛtya+sadā+ujjhita; always having abandoned duties for own purpose

quick_english: He is always unpleasant, always satisfied, always nourished, and always worshipped.

tokens.grounds: compound: sadā+apriya; always unpleasant or not dear in ordinary sense
compound: sadā+tuṣṭa; always satisfied
compound: sadā+puṣṭa; always nourished or flourishing
compound: sadā+arcita; always worshipped

quick_english: He has a thousand names, belongs to three ages, has four forms, and four arms.

tokens.grounds: compound: sahasra+nāman; having a thousand names
compound: tri+yuga; associated with three ages
compound: catur+mūrti; having four forms
compound: catur+bhuja; having four arms

quick_english: He is Nārāyaṇa, with hair like muñja grass, and emerged beyond all yoga.

tokens.grounds: proper name of the deity
compound: muñja+keśa; having hair like muñja grass
compound: sarva+yoga+vinissṛta; emerged from or beyond all yoga

quick_english: He is the best among the Sādhyas, an ancient seer, devoted to steadfastness and peace.

tokens.grounds: compound: sādhya+śreṣṭha+purāṇa+ṛṣi; best among Sādhyas and ancient seer
compound: niṣṭhā+śānti+parāyaṇa; devoted to steadfastness and peace

quick_english: He is Nara and Kṛṣṇa, Hari, the son of Dharma, and one who lives by dharma.

tokens.grounds: compound: nara+kṛṣṇa; Nara and Kṛṣṇa together
proper name Hari
compound: dharma+nandana; son of Dharma
compound: dharma+jīvana; one whose life is dharma

quick_english: He is beyond time, conqueror of Kandarpa, and the lord of sages seen by Urvaśī.

tokens.grounds: compound: vi+kāla; beyond or free from time
compound: jita+kandarpa; conqueror of Kandarpa (desire)
compound: urvaśī+dṛś+muni+īśvara; lord of sages seen by Urvaśī

quick_english: He consists of all gods, is the teacher of Brahmā, and the lord of the goddess of speech.

tokens.grounds: compound: sarva+deva+maya; consisting of all gods
compound: brahma+guru; teacher of Brahmā
compound: vāg+īśvarī+pati; lord of the goddess of speech

quick_english: He is worthy of honor from all, destroyer of the world's dullness, and the slayer of Madhu.

tokens.grounds: compound: sarva+arhaṇa; worthy of honor from all
compound: jagat+jāḍya+nāśaka; destroyer of the world's dullness
compound: madhu+sūdana; slayer of Madhu

quick_english: He is the primeval knower, maker of the Veda, the very self of the Veda, and an ocean of scripture.

tokens.grounds: compound: ādi+vidvas; primeval knower
compound: veda+kartṛ; maker of the Veda
compound: veda+ātman; whose self is the Veda
compound: śruti+sāgara; ocean of scripture

quick_english: He is the king of knowledge, king of wisdom, an ocean of wisdom, and of unbroken intellect.

tokens.grounds: compound: vidyā+rāja; king of knowledge
compound: jñāna+rāja; king of wisdom
compound: jñāna+sindhu; ocean of wisdom
compound: akhaṇḍa+dhī; of unbroken intellect

quick_english: He pervades the wind and ocean in play and is the promulgator of the four Vedas.

tokens.grounds: compound: līlā+vyāpta+anila+ambhodhi; pervading wind and ocean through play
compound: catur+veda+pravartaka; promulgator of the four Vedas

quick_english: He made the host of gods immortal and is the cause of the origin of nectar.

tokens.grounds: compound: amarī+kṛta+deva+ogha; one who made the multitude of gods immortal
compound: pīyūṣa+utpatti+kāraṇa; cause of the origin of nectar

quick_english: He is the slayer of Hiraṇyākṣa, lord of the earth, and ordainer of śrāddha and other rites.

tokens.grounds: compound: hiraṇyākṣa+hara; slayer of Hiraṇyākṣa
compound: pṛthvī+pati; lord of the earth
compound: śrāddha+ādi+kalpaka; ordainer of śrāddha and other rites

quick_english: He is the excellent sole enjoyer of oblations and libations, and the sole giver of excellent virtues.

tokens.grounds: compound: havya+kavya+eka+bhuj+bhavya; excellent sole eater of oblations and libations
compound: guṇa+bhavya+eka+dāyaka; sole giver of excellent virtues

quick_english: He is the great boar, destroyer of those who harm sacrifice, and the refuge of sacrificers.

tokens.grounds: compound: mahā+varāha; the great boar incarnation
compound: yajña+ghna+dhvaṃsana; destroyer of those who slay sacrifice
compound: yājñika+āśraya; refuge of sacrificers

quick_english: He is the one hero of wondrous strength and the sole breaker of yantras and mantras.

tokens.grounds: compound with sandhi: eka+vīra+adbhuta+bala; sole hero of wondrous strength
compound: yantra+mantra+eka+bhañjana; sole breaker of yantras and mantras

quick_english: He has nails harder than millions of thunderbolts and bears a form as difficult to behold as a mighty elephant.

tokens.grounds: bahuvrīhi compound: koṭi-vajra-adhika-nakha; describes the nails as exceeding millions of thunderbolts in hardness
compound with upapada: gaja-duṣprekṣa-mūrtti-dhṛk; dhṛk from √dhṛ, bearer of a form as formidable and difficult to gaze upon as an elephant
